prompt: Build a map from field name to type name for any class, skipping static fields, using getDeclaredFields. Complete the starter file, then run the tests.
explanation: getDeclaredFields reports every field a class writes, private and static alike, so any tool that walks an object's state has to filter deliberately. Modifier.isStatic(field.getModifiers()) is the standard test, because a static field belongs to the class rather than to any instance. Field.getType() hands back a Class object describing the declared type, and getSimpleName gives the short, readable form -- including the [] suffix for arrays and the erased name List for a generic field. A LinkedHashMap keeps the insertion order, which here mirrors the order the fields were written in the source.
hints: One for-each loop over c.getDeclaredFields() is all you need; continue past the fields you want to skip.
field.getModifiers() returns an int of flag bits -- read it with Modifier.isStatic rather than doing bit arithmetic yourself.
The key is field.getName() and the value is field.getType().getSimpleName(); getType() alone would give you the full name with its package.
